principle: Kinship is persistent relational world state and is separate from household, affection, friendship, care, guardianship, inheritance and legal status.
rules: Kinship does not automatically create friendship, affection, trust, obedience, care, access, property or secret knowledge.
Household and kinship are independent graphs.
Separate residence does not erase kinship.
Death does not erase kinship history.
Biological parentage is created only by an authorized lifecycle/reproduction record.
Adoption, guardianship and legal family status require applicable legal/social rules.
Affective partnership does not automatically create parentage or kinship.
Kinship facts and character knowledge of kinship are separate.
Disputed or unknown kinship may exist without rewriting authoritative truth.
LOD and save/load do not reroll family relations.
AI cannot invent family relations for drama or dialogue.
